grammar.title: 现在完成时的全部完成与部分完成

parts.text: How long have you been married? 你们结婚多久了?

headers: 全部完成 到目前为止已经完成（过去发生,影响现在）
部分完成 表持续（未完成）
rows: I have finished Book 1. 全部完成(可转换为“一般过去时”) I finished Book 1. 一般过去时
She has lived in Beijing for ten years.
just, already, before, never, ever, yet…
since, for…

parts.text: For a month. 一个月了。
Since a month ago. 自从一个月以来

rows: Have you ever…? Have you …yet?
When did you …? Where did you …? How did you …?
Have you read this book yet? Yes. I have.
When did you read it? I read it last year.
Have you done your homework yet? Yes, I have.
Where did you read it? I read it at home. When did you do it? I did it half an hour ago. Where did you do it? I did it at home.
Has he gone yet? Yes, he has.
When did he go? He went an hour ago. How did he go? He went by car.
Has she spoken to him yet? Yes, she has.
When did she speak to him? She spoke to him yesterday. How did she speak to him? She spoke to him pleasantly.
